claims.summary: Over every field of characteristic three, for every d>=5 with d=5 mod9, the original generic dimension-seven root-curve series V_(7,d) has Hasse orders0,...,64d-129. The full a3->a1 survivor is (v,v^2,w^7,vw^7) F_(2c+1), c=8d-17, and is normal. Other degree residues, primes, dimensions and pre-stable thresholds are not asserted.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by one isolated medium reviewer. The odd-cube residual profiles are ordinary because (2c+1)(2c+3) is a unit. Six odd-part Hasse conditions, one value cut and six high coefficients give an exact thirteen-condition criterion. Its fixed determinant factors with final factor u^3 X+u^6 Y+C(Y-u^3 X), whose actual leading term is2u^3 for every N=64d-128. The independent control checks the full source, every normalized matrix entry and determinant at d5,p3.
claims.rationale: Extends the earlier ternary congruence family modulo27 to its full profile modulo9, including an infinite family on which both previously used full boundaries fail.
claims.next_action: Develop the other characteristic-three degree profiles using the third merge's actual exceptional blocks and odd-part Hasse cuts.

claims.summary: In characteristic three, for every d>=5 with d=23 mod27, both the first full survivor W=vA+w^3A+v^2B+vw^3B and alternative full survivor Z=vA+wA+v^2w^2C+vw^3C of the dimension-seven paired source have nontrivial generic length-N Hasse kernels, N=64d-128. No exact corank is asserted. The original V_(7,d) is normal by the third-survivor theorem.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by one isolated medium reviewer. The full c=5 mod9 profiles have exact thirteen-condition maps. Their local state N=21 mod27 substitutes (1+t^3)(1+2t^9) in all high rows. Both formal determinants vanish identically before actual global powers are imposed. The nonconstant surviving-parameter ratio and common scaling establish generic boundary scope. This refutes these two boundary mechanisms, not the original series.
claims.rationale: Prevents repeating a failed boundary calculation on an infinite degree class; the simultaneous success of the third full limit identifies source choice as the issue.
claims.next_action: Use the third survivor for this resolved class; retain full-source and genericity checks when treating other classes.
